exact_result: For every continuous real-PA PC reference on finite rational spatial domains of the unit-weight six-cone U3,4 carrier in Z^3, positive on every nonzero recession direction of each reference cell, construct a nonnegative compactly supported real-PA obstacle whose actual finite rational-domain PAPC envelope equals the reference exactly outside a compact set and has complete recursive contact defect -8*epsilon*lambda^2<0. Every supporting lemma is reconstructed. The explicit rho reference has all nine atoms computed, total mass 24 and contact defect -1/2.
concrete_gaps: The original classification of all balanced rational polyhedral pairs satisfying all-obstacle orthogonality remains open.
No whole-pair all-envelope regularity theorem is proved, even on this negative carrier; only the constructed envelopes are PAPC.
Other singular or Bergman carriers and any precisely specified higher-dimensional intrinsic contact package are not classified.
No arbitrary non-PA PC approximation theorem, literal integral-slope result, analytic realization, or P06.2 result is asserted.
